approach: I followed the requirement-steps REQ-07 procedure: draft the TRD from the PRD, the prototype and the current architecture, using the TRD template sections from org.templates. The previous REQ-07 run ended blocked. Its judge records (steps/FEAT-ZD-48600/REQ-07/judge_attempt*.json) faulted it for treating facts the app code already answers as unknowns, so this time I read the code in all four app repositories first: the source, __init__, CI and test files. I wrote those facts up as cited baseline findings F-1 to F-15. Two of them are real conflicts in existing code that the Architect needs to see: bucket_for(30) returns "31-60", and formatAmount formats through a binary float. On that baseline I wrote components (C-1 to C-10), interfaces (IF-1 to IF-8, including a proposed ap_aging→ap_portal JSON contract CT-1), data (D-1 to D-8), security and tenancy (S-1 to S-6), testing approach (T-1 to T-17), risks (R-1 to R-11), assumptions, new open questions (TQ-1 to TQ-11), PRD-to-TRD traceability and a validation check against the decision log and lessons. Every design choice is labelled as agent judgement. I then had the verifier subagent check the draft against its sources. It confirmed F-1 to F-15 and found no number missing from its source. I fixed the seven smaller points it raised: an incomplete CI citation, AC-3 reject-reason precedence (now TQ-10), amount padding against the prototype wording (now TQ-11), quantising pipeline amounts, the version assumption, the no-new-scope wording, and csv.DictReader short rows. No connector was needed, and the step allows no shell commands.
